text:
Maya Okafor illustrates the kind of picture books that get read until the spines give out. Working from a sunlit studio in Bristol, she paints in gouache and coloured pencil, building worlds full of mischievous foxes, rain-soaked city streets and grandmothers who keep secrets in their cardigan pockets. Her work has appeared in more than twenty titles for publishers including Walker Books and Nosy Crow, and her debut, *The Lighthouse Cat*, was shortlisted for the Klaus Flugge Prize. When she isn't drawing, Maya runs free workshops at local libraries, where she insists every child leaves with ink on their fingers.
